audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible builds from damage he TAKES as well as damage he deals. Poking him is therefore how his shield gets large, and the page tells you to run a spirit-poke war without ever saying so.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.'
audit.corrected: Your chip is his shield. Poke to set up the kill window, then burst through — and have Grievous Wounds up before he consumes it, because the shield converts into a heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Obliterate deals INCREASED damage when it hits a single enemy. Standing next to a minion is a free damage reduction on his main trading tool, and it is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.'
audit.corrected: Never take his Q alone if a minion can share it — the isolated version is the one that hurts.

Riot's description is a plain ground smash with no grounding effect, so per the brief I trusted the description and wrote no grounding claim — worth a targeted check, because if Obliterate grounds it would be the most important fact on this page for a champion whose W and R are both dashes.
